_doc: Window 4b run list: L11 C2 tip (f8873aae) against its parent C0 (146a1125), G9 of 02-DESIGN-REV1.md.
Protocol = the window-3 block (P0b ruling): a cell = MEDIAN over K separate processes of the process's
window mean (ms/step); spread = min-max, IQR, SE of the median 1.2533*SD/sqrt(K); a comparison is claimed
iff |effect| > 2*hypot(SE_A, SE_B) (G9's form) and is also printed under the min-max reading; 5-s load
receipt before/after every process (> 5 % busy or a build process => re-run once at the end of its pass);
10-s receipt before each pass; idle rule (wait_idle3.ps1) before each pass; no band void; placement P-none.
Two binaries 'parent'/'tip' interleaved inside each W group, pass 1 reversed, one untimed warm-up per pass.
Every expected_pose is asserted per process (summary pose_hash) AND the tip additionally runs with
--expect-pose <gate/<row>_W1_parent.pose> (the parent's pose from the untimed pose gate; the pose is W-independent).
Jolt is NOT run in this window (owner ruling: v5.6.0 only, and its window-3 cells are reused, never re-run).

armed_block.note: reduced to 3 rounds per pass (K=6) if time presses; the report says which

protocol.order: pass 0: W ascending; inside a W group row by row, parent then tip; pass 1: the whole list reversed
